story.titleZh: 沃尔夫支持MotoGP对卡塔尔站异议的处理
story.summaryZh: 梅赛德斯F1领队托托·沃尔夫在F1计划于该地区办赛之前，对MotoGP处理车手对卡塔尔大奖赛异议的方式表示支持。MotoGP本周末在卢赛尔赛道办赛，22名全职车手中16人参赛，仅雅马哈厂队和Pramac卫星车队缺席。
story.originalTitle: Wolff backs MotoGP's handling of calendar dissent
story.summaryEn: Mercedes Formula 1 boss Toto Wolff has backed MotoGP's handling of rider discontent over its Qatar Grand Prix, ahead of F1's own planned races in the region. MotoGP is competing at Qatar's Lusail circuit this weekend with 16 of its 22 full-time riders in action, while only the Yamaha factory team and satellite team Pramac are absent.
detailZh: 梅赛德斯F1领队托托·沃尔夫在F1计划于该地区办赛之前，对MotoGP处理车手对卡塔尔大奖赛异议的方式表示支持。
当F1齐聚因特拉戈斯参加巴西大奖赛时，MotoGP在同一周末于卡塔尔卢赛尔赛道办赛，22名全职车手中有16人（外加两名伤替补）参赛。
此前MotoGP车手之间进行了数次秘密且非正式的投票，多数人因担心中东冲突升级而投票反对举办卡塔尔站比赛。
但最终，只有雅马哈车手——即代表厂队和卫星车队Pramac的车手——在没有替补的情况下缺席卡塔尔大奖赛。
雅马哈上周日宣布，它“未找到充分理由来改变其现有的全公司差旅限制”，因此无法派车队前往卡塔尔，这一决定遭到了MotoGP的“失望”回应，并暗示可能带来“体育层面的后果”。
该赛事系列强调，在与卡塔尔、赛道以及“独立安全顾问”协商后，它并未“收到任何足以改变当前赛事计划的信息”。
至于已在卡塔尔的车手们，有些人对赛事处理方式采取了较为和解的立场，但另一些人则保持了更为对抗的语气。
值得注意的是，七届赛事冠军马克·马奎斯在赛前新闻发布会上表示：“我更希望自己身在别处。因此，我会尽可能搭乘最晚的航班抵达，并尽可能搭乘最早的航班离开。”
F1在该地区安排了两场比赛——11月29日的卡塔尔大奖赛和12月6日的阿布扎比大奖赛。
当在英特拉格斯被问及他对这两场比赛相关情况的理解是否受到了本周末在卡塔尔举行的MotoGP赛事的影响时，沃尔夫给出了详尽的回答，支持MotoGP的处理方式，并对车手们公开分享的内容提出了质疑。
“斯特凡诺[多梅尼卡利，F1掌门人]和穆罕默德[本·苏拉耶姆，国际汽联主席]对局势说得非常清楚，F1遵循国际准则，无论是旅行限制、航空公司停飞、该地区的任何警告，还是地方政府给出的那类反馈——所以不仅是推广方，还有地方政府给出的反馈。在我看来，这就是你需要依赖的东西，”沃尔夫说。
“我完全赞同这一点。我认为，如果车手站出来，对地缘政治一无所知，但他们有听众在听，我觉得这能制造媒体价值[头条新闻]——但我会做和MotoGP管理层一样的事。”
“你想骑车，或者开车，就去。如果你不想，就别去。就这么简单。
“而且每个人都可以就此做出自己的个人决定，我尊重这一点。当然，你必须警惕接下来几天或几周内发生的事情。
“斯特凡诺（Stefano）掌握着脉搏，能够监测这一点。如果情况变得更加危险，那么他将与穆罕默德（Mohammed）一起，成为第一个保护那些本应出行的人的人。所以这就是为什么我遵循我所听到的指导。
“内部没有提出过这个问题，也没有成为话题。但同样，如果有人觉得自己出行感到不舒服，那是我一直会尊重的事情。”
也许这是一个给别人机会的契机。
“这不会改变双方的关系。我一直尊重这一点，有些人不想去某些大奖赛。目前我就是这么看的。”——瓦尔·霍鲁恩日伊
沃尔夫发表上述言论之际，一级方程式即将迎来决定2026赛季如何收官的关键一周。
一段时间以来，伊莫拉一直在准备其场地，作为中东最后几站比赛无法举行时的备选方案。
然而，现在已到了必须决定是进行最后的主要准备工作还是放弃这项工作的时刻，因为卡塔尔和阿布扎比的比赛即将举行。
据了解，F1已为自己设定了下周二（11月10日）的最后期限，以就伊莫拉赛事如何处理做出最终决定。
如果到那时F1确信中东赛事可以顺利进行，那么伊莫拉就可以被取消。
然而，这一决定意味着，如果在该日期之后中东紧张局势升级，卡塔尔和阿布扎比的比赛不得不停止，那么伊莫拉将无法再举办比赛——这意味着本赛季将在拉斯维加斯结束。
尽管中东局势仍然难以预测，F1车队依然相信在最终决定中不会冒任何“风险”。
阿斯顿·马丁车队赛道运营主管迈克·克拉克表示，尽管车队人员就正在发生的情况提出了更多疑问，但大家对F1高级管理层抱有信心。
克拉克周四在英特拉格斯表示：“今天上午我与安迪（史蒂文森，赛事总监）详细讨论了此事，我们认为，我们真的确信，F1没有冒任何不必要的风险。”
“他们了解当前局势，掌握的信息远比我们充分。我认为，如果存在严重风险，他们会采取正确的行动。”
“我认为目前他们仍在评估那一情况，而且我相信他们已经为自己设定了一些截止期限，而我们还没有越过那些期限。所以，我认为我们需要给他们时间去做这件事。但如果他们冒险，我会非常惊讶。”——乔恩·诺布尔
detailEn: Mercedes Formula 1 boss Toto Wolff has backed MotoGP's handling of its Qatar Grand Prix amid rider discontent, ahead of F1's own planned races in the region.

While F1 has gathered at Interlagos for the Brazilian Grand Prix, MotoGP is competing at Qatar's Lusail circuit on the same weekend - with 16 of the 22 full-time riders (and two injury replacements) in action.
This followed several secret and unofficial votes between the MotoGP riders, in which the majority had voted against holding a Qatar race due to fears of conflict escalation in the Middle East.
In the end, though, only the Yamaha riders - those representing the factory team and the satellite team Pramac - are absent from the Qatar GP without replacement.

Yamaha announced last Sunday that it "had not identified sufficient grounds to change its existing company-wide travel restrictions" to send its teams to Qatar, a decision that was met with "disappointment" and suggestion of "sporting consequences" from MotoGP.
The series emphasised it did not "receive any information that would warrant a change to the current plans for the event" after consultation with Qatar, the track and "independent safety advisors".
As for the riders present in Qatar, some have taken a more conciliatory stance over the handling of the event, but others have maintained a more confrontational tone.

Notably, seven-time series champion Marc Marquez said in the pre-event press conference: "I would like to be in another place. For that reason I arrive on the latest flight possible, and I will leave on the earliest flight possible."
F1 has two races scheduled in the region - November 29's Qatar GP, and December 6's Abu Dhabi GP.

And when asked at Interlagos whether his understanding of the situation with those races was being informed with MotoGP racing at Qatar this weekend, Wolff offered an extensive answer that backed MotoGP's approach and questioned what the riders have shared publicly.

"Stefano [Domenicali, F1 boss] and Mohammed [Ben Sulayem, FIA president] have been pretty clear about the situation, that Formula 1 follows what the international guidelines are, whether there's travel restrictions, airlines not flying, any warnings in the region, the kind of feedback that local governments are making - so not only the promoters, but what the local governments are making. And this is what you need to rely on, in my opinion," Wolff said.

"And I'm fully with that. I think that if riders stand up, that geopolitically know nothing about what's going on but [they] have the audience that listens, I think that is something that creates media value [headlines] - but I would have done the same that MotoGP management has done.
"You want to ride, or drive, go. If you don't want to, don't go. As simple as that.
"And everybody can take their personal decisions on that, and I respect it. Of course, you've got to be wary of what's happening in the next few days, or few weeks.

"And Stefano has the finger on the pulse to monitor that. If things were to get more dangerous, then he's going to be the first one, together with Mohammed, to protect the people that were meant to travel. And so that's why I'm following the guidance of what I'm hearing.
"Internally it hasn't been raised, hasn't been a topic. But also there, if someone feels he or she doesn't feel comfortable in travelling, then it's something that I would always respect.
"And maybe that's an opportunity to give somebody else a chance.
"It wouldn't change anything for the relationship. I've always respected that, that some people didn't want to go to certain grands prix. And that's how I see it at the moment." - Val Khorounzhiy
Wolff’s comments come ahead of a crunch week for Formula 1 when it comes to defining how the 2026 season will end.
For a while now, Imola has been getting its venue ready as a fallback option in case the final Middle Eastern races cannot happen.
However, it is now at the point where it needs to commit to the final major preparations or abandon its work because the races in Qatar and Abu Dhabi are happening.
It is understood that F1 has set itself a deadline of next Tuesday (November 10) to make a final call on what to do with the Imola event.
If by then it is satisfied that the Middle Eastern races are good to go, then Imola can be stood down.

That call means, however, that if after that date tensions escalate in the Middle East and the races in Qatar and Abu Dhabi have to be halted, then it means Imola will not be able to host any more – which means the season would finish in Las Vegas.
While the situation in the Middle East remains unpredictable, F1 teams retain faith that no "risks" will be taken in the final call.
Aston Martin chief trackside officer Mike Krack said that despite team personnel asking more questions about what was happening, there was confidence in F1’s senior management.

Speaking on Thursday at Interlagos, Krack said: “Now, I discussed it at length with Andy [Stevenson, sporting director] this morning, and we think, we are really convinced, that F1 is not taking any unnecessary risk.
“They are aware of the situation, they have much better information than we have. And I think if there is a serious risk, I think they will take the correct action.

“I think at the moment they are still evaluating that situation, and I’m sure they have set themselves some deadlines, which we have not gone over yet. So, I think we need to give them the time to do that. But I would be really surprised if they take risks.” - Jon Noble
keyPointsZh: MotoGP车手此前进行了数次秘密且非正式的投票，多数人因担心中东冲突升级而投票反对举办卡塔尔站比赛。
雅马哈上周日宣布，未找到足够理由改变公司范围内的出行限制，因此不派车队前往卡塔尔，MotoGP对此表示失望并暗示会有竞技层面的后果。
keyPointsEn: MotoGP riders held several secret and unofficial votes, in which the majority voted against holding a Qatar race due to fears of conflict escalation in the Middle East.

Yamaha announced last Sunday that it had not identified sufficient grounds to change its company-wide travel restrictions, so it did not send its teams to Qatar; MotoGP expressed disappointment and suggested there would be sporting consequences.

detailZh: 乔治·拉塞尔夺得杆位，梅赛德斯车队在卡塔尔大奖赛排位赛中占据领先，这是自5月份加拿大大奖赛以来的首次。

relatedItems.titleZh: 安东内利与梅赛德斯包揽卡塔尔大奖赛练习赛
relatedItems.summaryZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Antonelli and Mercedes sweep Qatar GP practice
detailZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
在排位赛前的20分钟内，练习赛中的圈数非常少。似乎很少有车手能在他们的第一次排位赛中取得更好的成绩。
安东内利的队友乔治·拉塞尔在第二阶段的表现中保持了领先，尽管他在著名的14号弯角发生了一次打滑，那里的地板损坏总是令人担忧，这使安东内利得以缩小到落后0.017秒。
但在第三次尝试中，安东内利全速前进，逆转了排名，领先拉塞尔0.249秒，这个成绩无人能及。
梅赛德斯的车手在任何时刻都落后了半秒左右，红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘在练习结束时排名第三，落后安东内利0.510秒。
维斯塔潘的队友伊萨克·哈德贾排名第四，领先略有提升的法拉利车手查尔斯·勒克莱尔，勒克莱尔在周五的比赛中表现不佳，非常悲观。
勒克莱尔的队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿排名第九，抱怨赛车转向不足，并要求增加前翼角度以避免提前进站。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂在最后一次性能测试跑之前排名第三，但在第六和第七位时被麦凯轮车队的兰多·诺里斯超越，最终排名下降。
皮亚斯特里是众多抱怨转向不足的车手之一。
小红牛在周五表现得非常乐观，并在FP3练习中领跑中游，Arvid Lindblad排名第八，劳森排名第十，领先其中游对手两十分。
阿尔派恩落后小红牛很多，小红牛在车队积分榜上领先Enstone车队27分，争夺第五名。加斯利在FP3练习中排名第14，队友科拉平托排名第16。
科拉平托在最后阶段幸运地避开了高速移动的斯特罗尔，这一事件将在练习结束后进行调查。
在劳森和加斯利之间是奥迪和哈斯车队的奥利·贝尔曼，他的队友拉斐尔·卡马拉排名第15。
费尔南多·阿隆索超越了两辆威廉姆斯赛车，为阿斯顿·马丁赢得了第17名。
凯迪拉克车队以瓦尔特里·博塔斯领先近0.7秒的成绩，排在最后一名塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯之前。
第17名 费尔南多·阿隆索（阿斯顿·马丁）+2.696秒
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli completed a hat-trick of practice sweeps in FP3 for the Qatar Grand Prix, as Mercedes' rivals appear to be fighting for the best of the rest with Red Bull taking that honour in third practice.
Very few laps were turned in the first 20 minutes or so, before qualifying runs. It appeared that few drivers could improve on their first qualifying efforts.

Antonelli's team-mate George Russell set the early pace and maintained that lead after the second performance runs despite a wide moment through the notorious Turn 14 - where floor damage is always a worry - and that allowed Antonelli to close in to just 0.017s behind.
But on the third attempts, Antonelli turned on the afterburners to flip the order and lead Russell by 0.249s, which would not be beaten.
Mercedes' challengers were regularly around half a second down at any given point, with Red Bull's Max Verstappen taking third at the end of the session, 0.510s adrift of Antonelli.
Verstappen's team-mate Isack Hadjar took fourth ahead of the slightly improved Ferrari of Charles Leclerc, who was very pessimistic after Friday's running.
Leclerc's team-mate Lewis Hamilton was down in ninth, complaining that the car was not turning in sufficiently and asking for more front wing angle to avoid understeer.
Oscar Piastri had been third before the last performance run attempt, but was jumped by McLaren team-mate Lando Norris as they ran sixth and seventh, shuffled down the order by the end.
Piastri was another of the many drivers complaining of understeer.
Racing Bulls was extremely bullish on Friday and did head the midfield in FP3 with Arvid Lindblad in eighth and Liam Lawson in 10th, two tenths clear of its midfield rivals.

Alpine was well behind Racing Bulls, which is 27 points ahead of the Enstone team in the chase for fifth in the constructors' standings. Pierre Gasly finished 14th and team-mate Franco Colapinto 16th in FP3.
Colapinto was lucky to avoid a slow-moving Lance Stroll at high speed in the closing stages and that incident will be investigated after the session.
Between Lawson and Gasly were the Audis and Haas driver Ollie Bearman, whose team-mate Rafael Camara finished 15th.
Fernando Alonso cleared both Williams to take 17th for Aston Martin.
Cadillac anchored the order with Valtteri Bottas nearly 0.7s ahead of last-place Sergio Perez.
17 Fernando Alonso (Aston Martin) +2.696s
keyPointsZh: 梅赛德斯竞争对手在练习赛中落后梅赛德斯约半秒。
keyPointsEn: Mercedes' challengers were around half a second behind at any given point.

relatedItems.titleZh: 韩泰启动F1轮胎测试并接触车队，准备竞标2029年供应合同
relatedItems.summaryZh: 韩泰已启动F1轮胎测试计划并与车队展开谈判，准备竞标从2029年起成为F1官方轮胎供应商。F1当前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Hankook emerges with serious F1 tyre supply push
relatedItems.summaryEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid to become the official F1 tyre supplier from 2029. F1's current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028.
detailZh: 据The Race了解，韩泰已启动一项F1轮胎测试计划，并与车队展开谈判，为竞标从2029年起成为大奖赛官方供应商做准备。
F1目前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。此前，这家意大利公司击败普利司通的竞争性报价，赢得了F1最近一次招标合同，覆盖2025至2027年。
今年6月，在国际汽联行使选择权后，其合同又延长了一个赛季。
然而，从2029年起，国际汽联将启动新的招标程序，届时似乎将出现新的竞争，以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
据了解，倍耐力希望先等待看到招标细节，然后再决定是否参与竞标，以延长其自2011年以来的当前合约期，而普利司通长期以来一直在评估重返F1的可能性，其代表已出席过多场比赛。
然而，现在有消息显示，韩泰也准备加入竞争，并且一直在暗中加大自身的努力。
该公司的代表被发现出现在最近的拉斯维加斯大奖赛上，据了解，这是他们继9月前往马德里之后，今年第二次造访F1比赛。
据The Race了解，韩泰利用这些行程会见了大多数车队，并与老板、首席执行官和其他高级管理人员讨论了计划。
然而，前往各地观看比赛——其中还包括2025年在中国、日本和新加坡举行的赛事——只是其为2029年做准备的努力的一方面。
据了解，韩泰已在公司内部组建了一支44人的专项工作组，为进入F1做准备。
除了投入研发能力和模拟器运行之外，该公司今年还使用一辆改装的F2同级测试车完成了两次F1轮胎开发测试，以评估潜在的轮胎结构以及不同配方。
第三次测试已安排用于研发其雨地轮胎，该公司希望这也能帮助其开发出一款具有更窄水雾羽流的轮胎，以减少湿地条件下造成的能见度问题。
韩泰也在努力进行生产和制造规划，以满足任何轮胎招标合同下供应F1、F2和F3轮胎所需。
韩泰对国际汽联的赛事当然并不陌生，这家韩国公司已经是世界拉力锦标赛的官方轮胎供应商，并且刚刚结束了对电动方程式锦标赛的供应，而普利司通将在即将到来的赛季接替。今年早些时候，韩泰还被指定为该管理机构的全球合作伙伴。
2029年之后的新F1轮胎招标期几乎肯定会涵盖向下一个规则时代的过渡，F1正着眼于更轻、更灵活的新赛车，以配合从2030年开始改用V8动力单元。
这些计划还将包括一种新的轮胎设计，该设计将比目前的18英寸设计略微减小车轮尺寸。
detailEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid on becoming grand prix racing’s official supplier from 2029, The Race has learned.

F1’s current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028, after the Italian company won F1’s most recent tender deal, which covered the period from 2025-2027, against a rival bid from Bridgestone.
Its contract was extended by a further season in June this year after an option was taken up by the FIA.
From 2029, however, a new tender process is set to be launched by the FIA and there looks set to be fresh competition to secure the right to be the official F1 supplier.

It is understood that Pirelli wants to wait to see details of the tender before deciding if it enters the fray to extend its current spell which stretches back to 2011, while Bridgestone has long evaluated an F1 return with representatives having attended races.
However, it has now emerged that Hankook is ready to throw its hat into the ring too and has been secretly ramping up its own efforts.
Representatives of the company were spotted at the recent Las Vegas Grand Prix, which was understood to have been their second visit to an F1 race this year following a trip to Madrid in September.
The Race understands that Hankook has used these trips to meet a majority of teams and discuss plans with bosses, CEOs and other senior executives.
The trips to races, which also included visits to events in China, Japan and Singapore in 2025, are only one side of its efforts to get ready for 2029, however.
It is understood that Hankook has already committed a 44-person task force within the company to prepare for an F1 entry.

Beyond committing research and development capability plus simulator running, it has this year completed two development tests for F1 rubber using a modified F2-equivalent-mule car to evaluate potential construction as well as different compounds.

A third test has been scheduled to work on its wet-weather rubber, which it hopes can also help it develop a tyre that features a narrower spray plume to reduce visibility problems caused in wet conditions.
Hankook is also working hard on production and manufacturing planning that would be required to supply F1, F2 and F3 tyres that would come under the umbrella of any tyre tender contract.

Hankook is certainly no stranger to FIA competition, with the South Korean company already the official tyre supplier to the World Rally Championship and has just ended its supply to Formula E where Bridgestone is taking over for the upcoming season. Earlier this year Hankook was also named as a global partner of the governing body.

The period of the new F1 tyre tender beyond 2029 will almost certainly cover the transition to the next rules era, with F1 setting sights on new lighter and nimbler cars to coincide with the switch to V8 power units from 2030.
The plans are also set to include a new tyre design, which is set to reduce wheel size slightly from the current 18-inch design.
keyPointsZh: 倍耐力在击败普利司通的竞争性报价后赢得2025至2027年的F1轮胎供应合同，今年6月国际汽联行使选择权将合同延长一个赛季。
国际汽联将从2029年起启动新的招标程序，届时预计将出现新的竞争以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
